sectors.name: Mining & Energy
themes: Indonesia's downstream processing mandate (smelter build-out) structurally re-rates nickel and tin miners as value-added exports replace raw ore, insulating them from commodity price swings.
Global energy transition demand for nickel (EV batteries) and tin (soldering/semiconductors) creates durable volume growth, with Indonesia controlling ~50% of nickel supply and ~25% of tin supply.
Domestic coal demand from new smelters and power plants, plus government DMO policies, provides a stable earnings floor for coal miners like AGII despite global thermal price volatility.
sectors.ai: Buy selective nickel and tin names (INCO, TINS) on Indonesia's downstream smelter ramp and tight global tin supply; ALKA/FPNI are speculative spikes, take profits. Watch US rate cuts for commodity beta, but domestic coal (AGII) remains supported by DMO and export quotas. Position for Q3 earnings beats in nickel/tin, avoid chasing BAJA/RMKO without volume confirmation.
